name: Gargoyles

unlocks.name: Gargoyle smasher
unlocks.notes: Automatically deals the finishing blow if the player has a rock hammer or equivalent in inventory.

unlocks.name: Bigger and Badder
unlocks.notes: Allows superior Slayer monsters, including Marble gargoyles, to spawn while on task.

unlocks.name: Double Trouble
unlocks.notes: Dusk and Dawn count for two kills toward the task rather than one; the task page strongly recommends avoiding this when killing Grotesque Guardians.

variantInfo.name: Gargoyle
notes: Standard gargoyles are found in the Slayer Tower.
Gargoyles in the basement are immune to poison and venom; upstairs gargoyles are not immune to either status.
Require a rock hammer, rock thrownhammer, or granite hammer finishing blow at 9 or lower Hitpoints.
Weak to both magic and crush attacks, though melee is commonly used.
Have -2 flat armour, making multi-hit weapons such as Dual macuahuitl useful.

variantInfo.name: Marble gargoyle
notes: Superior slayer monster variant that can spawn after purchasing Bigger and Badder.
Uses melee and ranged attack styles.
Special attack launches a white-red orb with 1x1 area damage that can entrap the player if not dodged.
Bring more emergency food if lower level because Marble gargoyles are more dangerous than regular gargoyles.

variantInfo.name: Dawn
notes: One half of the Grotesque Guardians duo.
For more information on the Grotesque Guardians, use the Grotesque Guardians strategy source.
Counts as part of a Gargoyles task after the brittle key unlocks the rooftop boss arena.

variantInfo.name: Dusk
notes: One half of the Grotesque Guardians duo.
Dusk has a second form at combat level 328.
For more information on the Grotesque Guardians, use the Grotesque Guardians strategy source.
Counts as part of a Gargoyles task after the brittle key unlocks the rooftop boss arena.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower top floor
notes: Contains 8 Gargoyles.
Running through the Slayer Tower floors passes dangerous monsters, notably banshees and aberrant spectres.
The task page image shows a safespot at the east side of the adjacent bookcase.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower basement
notes: Contains 12 Gargoyles.
Gargoyles can only be killed here while on a Slayer task.
Raulyn stops players attempting to fight basement Gargoyles off task.
Recommended for tasks because many Gargoyles are in a fairly small area.

locationComparison.name: Slayer Tower roof
notes: Grotesque Guardians boss arena with Dawn and Dusk.
Only available after receiving a brittle key drop from regular Gargoyles.
The Grotesque Guardians count as one kill unless Double Trouble is unlocked, after which they count as two.
Use the Grotesque Guardians strategy source for boss-specific mechanics.

taskNotes: Gargoyles require 75 Slayer, 80 combat, and Priest in Peril completion to be assigned.
They are only found in the Slayer Tower on the top floor, in the basement, or on the rooftop boss arena.
Gargoyles in the basement can only be killed on a Slayer task; Raulyn stops off-task attacks.
Gargoyles are weak to both magic and crush attacks, but melee is commonly used due to cost, their low melee defence, and limited safespot reliability.
Gargoyles have -2 flat armour, so weapons such as Dual macuahuitl are recommended to use the extra damage.
To kill a Gargoyle, use a rock hammer, rock thrownhammer, or granite hammer when it reaches 9 or lower Hitpoints.
Gargoyle Smasher costs 120 Slayer points and automatically smashes Gargoyles at 9 or lower Hitpoints if a rock hammer or equivalent is in inventory.
The granite hammer will automatically smash Gargoyles even without Gargoyle Smasher if it is equipped.
The rock hammer is faster than the rock thrownhammer because the thrownhammer has travel time.
If both rock hammer and rock thrownhammer are in inventory, the rock hammer is used in melee distance and thrownhammers are used outside melee distance.
Marble gargoyle is the superior variant and can spawn after Bigger and Badder; it uses ranged attacks in addition to melee.
Marble gargoyles can launch a white-red orb special attack that deals heavy 1x1 area damage and entraps players if not dodged.
Grotesque Guardians require a brittle key from on-task Gargoyles to unlock the rooftop boss arena.
Regular Gargoyles are much faster and need fewer supplies than the Grotesque Guardians.
Grotesque Guardians are more time-consuming, need higher stats and gear, and require more effort and supplies.
Grotesque Guardians are the only source of untradeable granite dust, which upgrades cannonballs into granite cannonballs with a max hit of 35 instead of 30.
It is strongly recommended to avoid Double Trouble when killing Grotesque Guardians because it makes the boss consume two task kills instead of one.
The basement is recommended during a task because many Gargoyles are close together and aggression can be reset twice for around 30 minutes of semi-AFK combat.
For basement semi-AFK, start from the north, run south-west after the first aggression loss, then east after the second aggression loss.
recommendedMethod: Use melee crush in the Slayer Tower basement with a rock hammer or granite hammer finisher. Use Protect from Melee for regular Gargoyles, watch Marble gargoyle specials, and avoid Double Trouble if choosing Grotesque Guardians.
